rule: Full Reproductive bulk ≥5 nTPM OR supported reproductive-cell RNA ≥5 nTPM (≥20 reads; indirect sites additionally need complete outside-cluster coverage and every outside value <5, with no curated normal-induction conflict) OR reliable mapped positive reproductive IHC for every member without an antibody conflict OR reviewed human reproductive protein covering every selected member OR supported developmental stage/lineage mean ≥5 TPM; ≥20 cells, ≥5 positive and ≥10% positive at ≥1 TPM. Presence evidence never overrides normal exclusions.

At least one measured compatible tumor sample >0 in native TPM or HPA pTPM OR reviewed reliable tumor protein. This establishes presence, not therapeutic abundance; do not add maxima from different samples.
Reliable non-Low positives in Vital/Protected supply Unsafe evidence; Manageable positives block CTA only; uncertain evidence remains unresolved. Low is flagged.

Combined normal bulk (HPA consensus, HPA brain, GTEx v11) is the only blocking requirement: every nonreproductive tissue concept measured for every protein member. The GTEx 52-context core, HPA tissue-cell, immune, DICE and cornea panels are used when present and never block a label.

HPA v23 average normal/(normal+Reproductive maximum) above 10% blocks the adult/placental route when its reference is positive and the comparison is complete. Use 38 contexts/29 anatomy units, including Disposable and excluding Permissive thymus. Supported embryonic evidence remains independent; its contrast is unassessed. This is not safety evidence.

A complete primary-locus annotated coding translation with no LoF/NMD annotation, incomplete tags, internal stops or non-AA20 residues; the selected common longest sequence must qualify for every member. Failure requires review, never Unsafe.

One inclusive tissue/IHC ceiling: above it in Vital/Protected supplies Unsafe evidence; above it in Manageable blocks CTA, and above 128 (the top Manageable ceiling) supplies Unsafe evidence. No second RNA boundary.
RNA requires ≥20 reads and uses the single ceiling. IHC credit requires an exact or declared compartment match; unrelated cells in the same tissue cannot inherit it.
Central cell-specific tiers with native nTPM limits and no matched negative-IHC credit; reproductive/placental location remains neutral.
Central cell-specific tiers with native TPM limits and no matched negative-IHC credit.
Third-highest reported TPM value; central cell-specific tiers. Unpaired group distributions retain bounds. Missing coverage alone does not exclude.
Recurrent native CP10K: ≥5 positive cells and ≥20 counts in ≥2 sample groups. Nominal RNA limits /100; not a TPM conversion. Missing coverage alone does not exclude.
Accepted positive protein findings exclude unless extracted Low intensity retains a flag; unquantified does not mean negative.

Reviewed adult human normal protein, or localized RNA with orthogonal normal-cell function, in Vital/Protected supplies Unsafe evidence. Sparse RNA, uncertain species/stage or unresolved identity produces a review hold. Activation and rare-cell frequency do not exempt normal cells. Every finding retains its source and limitations.
Retain reviewed product-specific clinical injury counterevidence and causal-attribution limits; no admission shortcut from clinical use.

At least 1% detection in a centrally assigned Vital population in the existing brain/spinal-cord/heart/lung CELLxGENE panel supplies Unsafe evidence. At least 3,000 cells and 10 expressing cells are required. Excluded or unmeasured populations are coverage limits, not allowances. Detection frequency is distinct from abundance.

At least 1% detection in a centrally assigned Protected population in the existing CELLxGENE panel blocks CTA admission without itself establishing Unsafe. The same cell-support criteria apply. Source age restrictions and detection artifacts remain limitations.
Use categorical/quantitative staining only within verified reagent, tissue and cell scope; no inherited HPA reliability label.

A would-be CTA with at least 95% of its 9-mers also present in Unsafe proteins becomes Other:Contained: Unsafe sequence is blacklisted, so almost no peptide survives. Computed over all protein-coding transcripts of Ensembl 115. This is a sequence rule, not expression evidence.

CTA requires all applicable admission gates, required coverage and resolved normal evidence. Unsafe exclusion takes precedence. Other includes assessed noncandidates, held/incomplete evidence, nested microproteins and sequence-contained candidates. Subtype and assessment_status answer different questions; an identity failure cannot erase a normal-evidence hold. Sequence roles require that independent status.
